stage: training-based lightweight representation adaptation (last search axis on DINOv2-B)
thesis_served: 验证 frozen DINOv2-B 的特征空间能否通过 normal-only lightweight adaptation 提升真实光照下的异常检测性能
why_now: E11/E12 已证明 scoring/fusion 层免训练或极轻修改收益上限 ~+0.01；必须测试特征空间本身轻量适配是否有更强正信号

exit.HOLD: 保留最简单 1 个候选
exit.NO_SURVIVOR: 关闭 DINOv2 representation adaptation axis，换 baseline/representation family

frozen_inputs.test: Bird/Car/Cube view120 (700 img), official image_anomaly + raw detectable
frozen_inputs.baseline: R0 = frozen DINOv2-B final-layer (reuse/reproduce E11/E12 values)

protocol_amendment_before_results.note: R2/R4 objective split was fixed BEFORE any formal result was viewed; not post-hoc tuning.
protocol_amendment_before_results.r2: L = L_preserve ONLY (ordinary lightweight representation adapter baseline)
protocol_amendment_before_results.purpose: R2 vs R4 = strict single-variable ablation measuring the incremental value of illumination consistency (same 768->128->768 residual MLP structure).

training.train_val_split: bank 300 -> train 240 / val 60 (sorted image path order)
training.early_stop: val consistency (R1/R3/R4) or val preservation (R2) no improvement for 30 steps, evaluated every 5 steps

collapse_gate.stop_if: feature std drop > 50% OR mean pairwise cosine > 0.98 OR feature norm explodes

decision_rules.KEEP: mean dAUROC >= +0.015 AND >=2/3 cat dAUROC >= +0.010 AND worst dAUROC >= -0.005 AND mean dAP >= +0.005 AND no collapse
decision_rules.HOLD: mean dAUROC >= +0.010 AND 3/3 dAUROC >= -0.005 AND mean dAP >= 0 AND no collapse

not_allowed_rescue: NO SURVIVOR -> close DINOv2 representation adaptation axis; do NOT tune lr/hidden/beta/augmentation to rescue
